buffett_estimate.source: CMV total market value scaled by the Wilshire 5000, divided by the latest GDP
buffett_estimate.wilshire_source: Yahoo Finance ^W5000, Wilshire 5000 Total Market Index
buffett_estimate.gdp_source: BEA NIPA table 1.1.5 (the series FRED publishes as GDP)
buffett_estimate.score_reason: This is the official market-cap-to-GDP ratio brought forward. The numerator is Current Market Valuation's total market value on its official date, scaled by the Wilshire 5000 Total Market Index, which matched that market value at about $1 billion per point. The denominator is the latest GDP. The official percentage is a separate, older print and is not averaged in.

baseline.rule: Sample standard deviation of msindex.net observations dated 1 January, from 1950 through the latest 1 January. The intra-year mark-to-market point is the current reading and is not part of the norm.
